name: travel-plan-saved-phone
seed: php artisan mock:sample-day travel --email=<account> && E2E_EMAIL=<account> php artisan db:seed --class="Database\Seeders\MockSample\PaperworkSeeder" && E2E_EMAIL=<account> php artisan db:seed --class="Database\Seeders\MockSample\TravelSeeder"

init: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.dataset.compare = 'static'; s.textContent = '#journey-view { max-height: none !important; overflow: visible !important; } .plan-back-row, .plan-actions { position: static !important; }'; document.head.append(s); })

if (location.pathname === '/up') { (async () => { const xsrf = decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.match(/XSRF-TOKEN=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] || ''); const headers = { Accept: 'application/json', 'X-XSRF-TOKEN': xsrf, 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }; try { const day = await (await fetch('/api/day?date=2026-09-30', { headers, credentials: 'same-origin' })).json(); for (const item of day.items || []) { if (item.planned) await fetch('/api/travel/planned-trips/' + item.planned.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers, credentials: 'same-origin' }); } } finally { location.replace('/travel?view=journey&activity=appointment%3A7b6c1f0e-2a4d-4e8b-9c3f-1d5e7a9b0c2d&compare=1'); } })(); }

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.dataset.compare = 'static'; s.textContent = '#journey-view { max-height: none !important; overflow: visible !important; } .plan-back-row, .plan-actions { position: static !important; }'; document.head.append(s); })

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '[title="Open the QA persona switcher"] { display: none !important; }'; document.head.append(s); })

note: Measuring aid, on both sides alike: the planner's own scrolling and its sticky bars (back row, Show the way / Add to plan) are made static, so an element scrolled into view for its screenshot isn't covered by a sticky bar or measured at a different scroll; layout and styles are otherwise untouched. The app's QA persona switcher (local only, not in the mock) is hidden: it floats over Add to plan on phones. Each width starts clean: the app side opens on /up, removes the account's planned way for the sample day (the app's own API), then opens Plan a trip, so the width before's Add to plan doesn't carry over (the mock starts clean at every width). Add to plan is given 10 s to answer before measuring (it took up to 5.6 s on a heavily loaded machine).
